Rule-Based Regex Matcher.strengths: Zero training required; ultra-low execution latency (<0.02ms).
Rule-Based Regex Matcher.limitations: Completely brittle to syntactic rephrasing, negations, and novel legal synonyms.

TF-IDF + Multinomial Naive Bayes.strengths: Fast probabilistic inference; effective on strong isolated keyword indicators.
TF-IDF + Multinomial Naive Bayes.limitations: Conditional independence assumption fails on nested legal conditions and long spans.

TF-IDF + Logistic Regression.strengths: Well-calibrated probability outputs; transparent n-gram feature coefficients.
TF-IDF + Logistic Regression.limitations: Linear boundary cannot model non-linear semantic interactions or hierarchical policy clauses.

TF-IDF + Linear SVM.strengths: High margin separation in sparse high-dimensional n-gram space; robust against class imbalance.
TF-IDF + Linear SVM.limitations: Lacks contextual word ordering and fails on dense paraphrasing across policy documents.

TF-IDF + Random Forest.strengths: Captures non-linear term co-occurrences; resilient to feature scaling.
TF-IDF + Random Forest.limitations: High memory footprint; slow tree traversal; cannot learn deep syntactic hierarchies.

GloVe + BiLSTM.strengths: Models sequential word order and bidirectional context across clause spans.
GloVe + BiLSTM.limitations: Vanishing gradients on long multi-line legal sentences; static embeddings miss polysemy.

BERT-base-uncased.strengths: Strong contextual self-attention over full clause sentences; rich pre-trained representations.
BERT-base-uncased.limitations: Absolute positional embeddings struggle with long legal distances; absolute token representations entangle content and position.

RoBERTa-base.strengths: Dynamic masking and longer pretraining improve robustness over standard BERT.
RoBERTa-base.limitations: Still couples positional and word vectors in cross-attention; lacks domain-specific legal vocabulary.

LegalBERT-base.strengths: Pretrained on legislation, court rulings, and EU contracts; excels on statutory legal phrasing.
LegalBERT-base.limitations: Statutory pretraining differs from consumer insurance fine print; sub-limits with numeric percentages remain challenging.

InsureCheck-NLP: Fine-Tuned DeBERTa-v3 (.strengths: Disentangled attention decomposes word content from relative position; hybrid TF-IDF ngram feature head guarantees zero catastrophic forgetting on statutory insurance formulas; 36% faster inference than BERT-base with higher accuracy.
InsureCheck-NLP: Fine-Tuned DeBERTa-v3 (.limitations: Requires GPU for high-throughput batching (>500 clauses/sec); dependent on clean PDF text layer extraction.
